blocks.text: Damped oscillation mein resistive forces (rukawat wali forces) ki wajah se oscillator der tak apni natural frequency par nahi jhool sakta aur amplitude aahista aahista kam hota jata hai. Lekin agar bahar se ek periodic (baar baar barabar waqfe se lagne wali) force lagayi jaye to amplitude constant rakha ja sakta hai; is force ko driving force kehte hain. Jab jhoolti body par periodic driving force lagti hai to us oscillation ko forced oscillation aur us force ki frequency ko driving frequency kehte hain. Engine chalne se gari ka thartharana forced vibration ki misal hai. Forced oscillation ka amplitude is baat par depend karta hai ke driving frequency aur body ki natural frequency ka aapas mein kya relation (talluq) hai.

Agar driving force ki frequency body ki natural frequency ke barabar ho to vibration ka amplitude bohat zyada barh jata hai. Is ko resonance kehte hain. Kitab ke mutabiq resonance tab bhi hoti hai jab lagayi gayi force ki frequency natural frequency ka integral multiple (poora guna) ho. Agar natural frequency f₁ ho to resonance in frequencies par hogi:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Jis body ki aik hi natural frequency ho (pendulum, spring par mass) us mein resonance sirf usi frequency par hoti hai, 2f ya 3f par nahi. Tani hui string aur hawa ke column ki kai natural frequencies hoti hain (f₁, 2f₁, 3f₁, …); un mein resonance in mein se kisi bhi frequency par ho sakti hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Simple pendulum ya spring par mass ki sirf ek natural frequency hoti hai, is liye woh sirf usi frequency par zor se jhoolte hain. Khinchi hui taarein (strings) aur hawa ke columns (pipes) ki kai natural frequencies hoti hain, f₁, 2f₁, 3f₁ waghera, aur woh har ek par resonate kar sakte hain. Multiple (guna) wali baat zyada tar aise systems par apply hoti hai.
Resonance dikhane ke liye ek asaan experiment (tajurba): pendulums ke do jore hain, A aur B jin ki lambai ℓ₁ hai, aur C aur D jin ki lambai ℓ₂ hai. Sab ek horizontal rod se latke hain (Fig. 14.17).

blocks.alt: Do stands ke darmiyan aik horizontal rod se paanch pendulum latke hain: P (hara), A, C, B aur D. P, A aur B ki lambai aik jaisi l1 hai; C aur D (laal) chhote hain, lambai l2.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.17: Alag alag length ke paanch pendulums ka set (kitab ki Figure 14.17 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Ab ek aur pendulum P lagate hain jis ki lambai badli ja sakti hai: ya ℓ₁ ya ℓ₂. Pehle P ki lambai ℓ₁ rakhein.

Jab P ko jhulaya jaye to us ki thartharahat rod ke zariye baqi pendulums tak pohanchti hai. A aur B ko rod se driving force milti hai; un ki lambai, natural frequency aur natural period P jaise hain, is liye resonance se un ka amplitude barhta jata hai. C aur D ki natural frequency P se alag hai, is liye woh taqreeban ruke rehte hain. Agar P ki lambai ℓ₂ kar di jaye to ab C aur D resonance se jhoolne lagte hain aur A aur B ruke rehte hain.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Earthquake (zalzala) ki seismic waves (lehrein) buildings (imaraton) ko upar neeche aur aage peeche hilati hain; earthquake mein buildings jhoolti hain. 8 October 2005 ko Azad Jammu aur Kashmir mein 7.6 magnitude (Richter scale) ka earthquake aaya jis ka centre (markaz) Muzaffarabad ke qareeb tha. Is mein 86 000 se zyada log jaan se gaye.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne earthquake ki magnitude (shiddat) '7.6 on reactor scale' chhapi hai. 'Reactor scale' naam ka koi scale nahi; earthquake ki magnitude Richter scale (ya moment-magnitude scale) par napi jati hai. Sahi 'Richter scale par 7.6' hai.
